data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2014 the syndicate's opening (prior-year comparative) gross claims outstanding was GBP 6.48m. During 2014 there was a net favourable prior-year movement of GBP 1.0m (net of reinsurance), reflecting reserve releases driven by a generally favourable claims environment. Releases were noted across several classes, primarily Property Reinsurance, Energy Upstream, War/Terrorism/Political Risk and Accident & Health. No gross prior-year movement figure was disclosed; the GBP 1.0m figure reported is stated net of reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from balance sheet prior-year comparative (explicit). No GROSS prior-year movement figure was disclosed in the notes; only a net of reinsurance over-provision of GBP 1.0m is stated. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is reported as the NET figure (release of 1.0m). Gross prior-year movement not available in the report; net figure used per fallback rules.
